title: C# Loops
description: Loops can execute a block of code as long as a specified condition is reached.

challenges.title: While Loop
challenges.exercise: Print i as long as i is less than 5. Start i at 0.

challenges.title: Do While
challenges.exercise: Use a do/while loop to print 0 once. Start i at 0.

challenges.title: For Loop
challenges.exercise: Use a for loop to print 1 to 3.

challenges.title: Break Statement
challenges.exercise: In a for loop (0 to 10), exit when i is 2.

challenges.title: Foreach Loop
challenges.exercise: Loop through string[] cars = {'Volvo', 'BMW'} and print each.
